richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a weld on the replacement lower front wishbone arm may not have been to the correct specification. The arm has a missing weld on the inner side of the mounting tube fixation to the wishbone arm. This could result in the arm failing without warning to the driver who could loose control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to inspect the lower front wishbone arm and if it is found that the weld is not to specificaition replace the arm.
